agyos_skill.instructions: Create high-converting comparison and alternatives pages that target competitive intent keywords with accurate, structured content. - Use when creating `X vs Y` comparison pages or alternatives pages. - Use when targeting competitor-intent keywords with SEO landing pages. - Use when the user needs structured comparison content, feature matrices, or conversion-oriented competitor pages. - Direct head-to-head comparison between two products/services - Balanced feature-by-feature analysis - Clear verdict or recommendation with justification - Target keyword: `[Product A] vs [Product B]` - List of alternatives to a specific product/service - Each alternative with brief summary, pros/cons, best-for use case - Target keyword: `[Product] alternatives`, `best alternatives to [Product]` - Curated list of top tools/services in a category - Ranking criteria clearly stated - Target keyword: `best [category] tools [year]`, `top [category] software` - Feature matrix with multiple products in columns - Sortable/filterable if interactive - Target keyword: `[category] comparison`, `[category] comparison chart` ``` | Feature | Your Product | Competitor A | Competitor B | |------------------|:------------:|:------------:|:------------:| | Feature 1 | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | | Feature 2 | ✅ | ⚠️ Partial | ✅ | | Feature 3 | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | | Pricing (from) | $X/mo | $Y/mo | $Z/mo |
